disposition: Additive VP-09 only. VP-01…VP-08 registers unchanged. VP-09.1 (0.9.1) adds four codes; 0.9.0 codes and their meaning unchanged.

codes.reference_rule: VP-09 §2 rows 1–2, AX-1, D-2, D-6: axis outside the closed set, reserved M/O, pair not declared, same axis twice (except X × X)

VP-09 §2 row 3, AQ-3, AX-4: F without method bindings, X without facet bindings, Y/Z without a referent of that home; in 0.9.1 an F axis without bindings is not FAIL but VP09_METHODS_NONE (VP-09.1 D-4)
VP-09 §2 row 4, AX-2, AQ-1: item without semantic_ref, 0.7.0 or invalid VP-07 source, malformed axes input
VP-09 AQ-1: from-plan context not /5, /6 or /7, or the unchanged VP-07 adapter refuses it; 0.9.1 also: method_profile_refs other than P1.11/migration-methods-v1 (VP-09.1 §2)
VP-09 §2 row 5, D-8, AQ-5: rows or columns over budget in a single view; detail never splits; more than 99 panels
VP-09 §2 row 6, D-7, AD-3: more entries than the per-cell budget; +n more drawn, full list in ledger; never a score
VP-09 §2 row 7, D-9: panel directory, inputs, units or coverage differ from a deterministic re-render; 0.9.1 also: panels do not account for every binding unit (VP-09.1 FL-3)
VP-09 §2 row 8: active SVG content, embedded ledger mismatch, drawn cells differ, unequal cell size or fill
VP-09 VP-07 rule: unreadable, oversized, duplicate-key or non-finite JSON
VP-09 VP-06 PE-5 rule: output already exists
VP-09 VP-06 PE-5 rule: staging or publish failed

VP-09.1 §2 row 1, FM-1, FM-2, D-5: method_id neither a P1.11 catalog ID nor a local method contract of the context; message names the method and its declaration_ref (P1.11 itself reports P1_MIGRATION_METHOD_UNKNOWN as UNRESOLVED)
VP-09.1 §2 row 3, D-4: F axis on an input without method bindings; empty F axis with a legend notice, not a statement about the plan
VP-09.1 §2 row 4, FL-2, D-2: binding argument whose referent has another home than the column axis (e.g. Y in F × Z); not drawn, listed in the binding ledger
VP-09.1 §2 row 5, FL-1, D-7: binding owner or argument outside the plan slice (--track, --subjects, --steps); listed in dropped_arguments and the binding ledger
